assets.name: jump
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated mobile puzzle game UI icon. Subject: An upward curving arrow lifting a small rounded cream cube, three tiny takeoff ticks. This is the JUMP action. Style: tasteful minimal softly beveled clay icon, broad clean silhouette, very subtle 3D depth, harmonious muted deep sage/teal (#34594f) with tiny warm ivory highlights. Cute refined Boxbound aesthetic. Center a single icon occupying 78% of a square image, equal clear margins. Real transparent alpha background. No square or rounded rectangle or circular background plate, no text, no letters, no border, no scenery, no watermark. High readability when reduced to 48 pixels. Deliver one icon only.
